footnote_text: In lieu of receiving cash fees, the reporting person received 187 stock units, which immediately vested, in the EnerSys Voluntary Deferred Compensation Plan for Non-Employee Directors (the "Plan").

This amount reflects a matching stock unit contribution by EnerSys for the reporting person's account in the Plan. The matching stock unit contribution vests 25% on each of January 15, 2027, April 15, 2027, July 15, 2027, and October 15, 2027. Such vesting is subject to acceleration or cancellation upon the occurrence of certain events. || As a result of these transactions the reporting person has an additional 224 stock units in the Plan. Each of these stock units represents a right to receive one share of EnerSys common stock and is payable upon the reporting person's Termination, as defined in the Plan.
